visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white boat-neck top, stands in the center of the frame against a neutral-colored wall. She holds a white tube and a light blue tube of cosmetic product toward the camera. Her facial expression is bright and welcoming as she speaks directly into the lens, using gentle hand gestures to emphasize her points about the products. (2) She proceeds to apply a small amount of lavender-tinted cream from the Elegance tube to the right side of her face. The camera maintains a medium close-up as she blends the product into her skin using her fingertips. A vertical white dotted line bisects the screen, with text labels 'Before' and 'After' appearing to highlight the immediate color-correcting and brightening effect on her complexion. (3) Next, she applies a pink-tinted cream from the Decorté tube to the left side of her face. The lighting is soft and even, showing the subtle glow and smooth texture the product provides. She moves her head slightly to catch the light, demonstrating the difference in finish between the two sides, pointing specifically at her cheekbones and pores to illustrate the blurring effect. (4) The scene transitions to a close-up shot of the back of her hand where she swatches both primers. She squeezes out a small amount of each, showing the lavender one is creamier while the pinkish one has a more fluid, watery consistency. She uses her fingers to spread them across her skin, demonstrating how easily they are absorbed under the bright indoor lighting. (5) In the final summary phase, she holds both tubes again while gesturing toward her face to show the long-term finish. She clenches her fists near her chin to compare the skin tone on her hands as well. She maintains a friendly smile and engaged eye contact, concluding with a close-up of her glowing skin and a final question displayed in text at the bottom.

An upbeat, major-key electronic pop track serves as the BGM, featuring rhythmic synthesizer chords and a light electronic drum beat. The overall mix is clean, with the vocals sitting prominently above the instrumental layer. (2) A crisp 'pop' sound effect occurs as the first product name is mentioned, indicating a synchronized visual-audio transition. The music continues without interruption, providing a consistent energy. The speaker's tone is informative and enthusiastic, maintaining high articulation clarity throughout her introduction of the two makeup primers. (3) During the demonstration of the textures, the speaker's vocal pitch modulates to emphasize descriptive adjectives. Short, melodic 'ding' sounds are intermittently heard when specific technical details like price and SPF appear on screen. There are no distracting ambient noises, suggesting a controlled recording environment with high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) In the final phase, the BGM remains constant as the speaker delivers a summary of the comparison. Her voice gains a bit more arousal, sounding slightly more excited as she reveals the 'winner' of her review. The segment concludes with a friendly parting phrase, followed by a quick fade-out of both the music and speech.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a side-by-side comparison of two popular Japanese makeup primers (Elegance vs. Decorté). It evaluates them based on visual skin finish, texture, SPF protection, and price, ultimately providing a recommendation to viewers looking for specific skincare benefits.
